findings.title: Design Decision 5 still has the final apply session read the gate before the account cue
findings.recommendation: Decision 5's last sentences say the session that checks the last task "reads the gate, follows the account cue and writes this change's account"; under D-opsd-8 the cue reads no gate. Reword to task 6.3's form: the session follows the account cue at its end, reads references/account-step.md and writes this change's account. The same entry's ripple left task 2.2 missing a comma before "that each basic content carries no condition of its own". Every normative site (Decision 1, the decision-records delta and its scenarios, the proposal, tasks 2.2 and 6.3, explore D-opsd-8) carries the fix; this one narrative site was missed because the phrase wraps across a line and the sweep's retired strings did not name it.

walk_entry.title: The account cue reads the apply gate before this session's emit declares user_validation_tasks, so a change ending on a user-validation handoff gets no account

findings.title: D-opsd-4's CONSUME move line still names new run-summary-schema.md files joining the schema-table parity test
findings.recommendation: explore.md:63 says new run-summary-schema.md files join the emit-composition schema-table parity test's set. Design Decision 2 put the moved text in references/run-summary-emit.md instead and left the schema references untouched, and the moved sections carry no schema block, so the parity test's set does not change. Re-point the move line to what holds now (its consumer is the agent composing the payload from run-summary-emit.md; the parity test is untouched) without changing D-opsd-4's rule. Not introduced by either walk: it predates the walk (Decision 2 at propose), and the blind pair did not name it.

commentary: Graded both walks against the six artifacts they edited, read whole. The account-cue rewrite (D-opsd-8) is in every normative site, including the decision-records delta's paragraph and both new scenarios, and the explore rules parse with D-opsd-4 and D-opsd-8 live and D-opsd-3 and D-opsd-5 superseded. The eleven-body cascade (D-opsd-9) checked by summing the context table (21,849 matches the eleven sections) and by the audit-drift claim that its body names run-summary-schema.md outside the emit section (SKILL.md line 213). The external log's two stale calls are right: each site carries log 1's fix. The residual range (from the external pass's adding commit) lists only files inside the walks' edit records.

verification.title: The account cue reads the apply gate before this session's emit declares user_validation_tasks, so a change ending on a user-validation handoff gets no account
The proposal names the reference files D-opsd-5 described; design, spec and tasks use one new run-summary-emit.md per skill
The table's 'the reference only' rows and the apply scenario's 'carries none of those' are false on day one
The account basic content does not follow the convention's handoff rule or name a non-zero exit
New body sentences are described, not given, and the spec calls the two-sentence cue 'one sentence'
The named limits do not cover a read lost to compaction before a later emit
Address-reviews' emit move saves nothing per turn and adds a read, and the cue misdescribes its reference
